title: Canvas Drawing Tool Test Cases — Runnable Companion
title_es: Casos de Prueba de Dibujo Canvas — Companion Ejecutable
description: Playwright 1.49 spec for HTML5 canvas drawing tools (mouse stroke, touch stroke, undo history, PNG export download) against a runnable pointer-events fixture, plus a Pillow pixel check for exported canvases.
description_es: Spec de Playwright 1.49 para herramientas de dibujo canvas HTML5 (trazo mouse, trazo touch, historial undo, download de export PNG) contra un fixture ejecutable de pointer events, más un chequeo de píxeles con Pillow para exports.
requirements: Node.js 20+; Playwright 1.49 for the spec; Python 3.11 + Pillow for the export check
